operations.name: TrackCargo
operations.body: query TrackCargo($id: TrackingId!) { cargo(trackingId: $id) { trackingId delivery { transportStatus } } }

operations.name: RegisterHandling
operations.body: mutation RegisterHandling($i: RegisterHandlingEventInput!) { registerHandlingEvent(input: $i) { handlingEvent { id } cargo { delivery { transportStatus } } userErrors { code } } }
